scope: All 40 current Wowhead class/spec basics guides plus 81 linked rotation/talent guide URLs. Dvalin public descriptions checked for 13 SBA videos.
policy: Only candidates are supported for SBA-compatible labeling. Coverage imports are generic starter builds retained for research, not automatically catalog eligible. None is claimed optimal, simulation-verified, or tested in game.

candidates.name: Fire Mage - Sunfury (SBA-compatible)
candidates.author: Preheat
candidates.evidenceSummary: The author discusses the displayed beginner build with SBA, using targeted Flamestrike and requiring manual Combustion.
candidates.notes: Author-recommended SBA-compatible starter; not an SBA optimization result. Manually use Combustion, trinkets, racials and other items.
candidates.treeCompatibility: Not checked in-game; validate against the live talent tree before spending.

candidates.name: Frost Death Knight - Deathbringer (SBA-compatible)
candidates.author: khazakdk
candidates.evidenceSummary: The author directly endorses using the displayed beginner build with the assisted highlight and single-button tools.
candidates.notes: Author-recommended SBA-compatible starter; not an SBA optimization result. The beginner build omits some capstone choices to simplify its rotation.
candidates.treeCompatibility: Not checked in-game; validate against the live talent tree before spending.

candidates.name: Beast Mastery Hunter - Pack Leader (SBA-compatible)
candidates.author: Tarlo
candidates.evidenceSummary: The author specifically recommends Pack Leader when using the assistant, matching the embedded beginner import.
candidates.notes: Author-recommended SBA-compatible starter; not an SBA optimization result. Manually handle items, utility and pet management. The author notes SBA misses minor optimizations.
candidates.treeCompatibility: Not checked in-game; validate against the live talent tree before spending.

candidates.name: Shadow Priest - Voidweaver (SBA-compatible)
candidates.author: EllipsisPriest
candidates.evidenceSummary: The author explicitly says the displayed beginner build works with the assistant except for manual Power Infusion.
candidates.notes: Author-recommended SBA-compatible starter; not an SBA optimization result. Use Power Infusion manually and manage utility, defensives and items yourself.
candidates.treeCompatibility: Not checked in-game; validate against the live talent tree before spending.

candidates.name: Brewmaster Monk - Master of Harmony (SBA-compatible)
candidates.author: Sinzhu
candidates.content: Beginner PvE; strongest assistant fit in single target
candidates.evidenceSummary: The author advises retaining Blackout Combo when using the assistant, tying the suggested talent choice to the embedded beginner build.
candidates.notes: Author-recommended SBA-compatible starter; not an SBA optimization result. Defensive abilities still need manual use. The guide reports weaker SBA behavior in AoE.
candidates.treeCompatibility: Not checked in-game; validate against the live talent tree before spending.
